subject.title: refactor: own model discovery by runtime lifecycle

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the prepared model-runtime generation as the permanent owner for model/auth/catalog discovery across gateway, embedded, and plugin-facing paths?
rationale: The implementation is a broad lifecycle architecture change with released plugin SDK readers and an intentionally deferred stream-registry ownership boundary; tests can validate mechanics but cannot select the permanent product and ownership model.

options.title: Adopt the lifecycle owner
options.body: Approve the prepared generation as the canonical owner after rebasing and confirming the SDK compatibility and reload/upgrade evidence.

options.title: Keep discovery incrementally scoped
options.body: Request a narrower performance change that retains the existing ownership boundary until the remaining global stream-registry design is settled.

recommendation.title: Adopt the lifecycle owner
recommendation.body: Approve the prepared generation as the canonical owner after rebasing and confirming the SDK compatibility and reload/upgrade evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch and its stated lifecycle design are concentrated in steipete’s recent runtime changes, while the final architectural direction remains a maintainer choice.
